scope: Selective metrics and logs label-index resolution; larger comparison/profiling workloads for all four signals. No native service performance comparison.

environment.shared_host: Existing demo broker, schema registry and three demo apps continue running. No compilers or profilers run during paired timing. Environment refreshes interrupted builds and one incomplete timing pass; incomplete results are excluded.

workload.fixture: Deterministic five-label series; one unique pod per series. Fixture construction outside query timer; returned full set consumed with black_box.
workload.budgets: 76 new IDs remain unseeded; all 85 historical numeric budgets unchanged.

mimir.finding: Intersect restrictive postings before subtracting negatives; streamed posting iterators.

loki.finding: Nested label-name/value dictionaries, sorted intersections and finite regex posting shortcuts.

rejected_initial_logs_candidate.reason: Already selective broad_equality_last regressed in all three pairs at 100k and 1m; refined to borrowed posting references and nested maps.

blockstore_unit.source_phase: Nested dictionary refinement, before final posting guard. Final public regressions and native comparisons recorded separately.

new_public_regressions.execution: Direct release test binaries against refined library, followed by Cargo-built integrations: 3 metrics and 2 logs tests; all pass.

loki_native.execution: Pinned Docker corpus suite; first run failed writing default /target evidence directory, corrected with TEST_UNDECLARED_OUTPUTS_DIR. Both logs preserved.

mimir_native.note: Pinned native suite enforces its existing bidirectional divergence ledger; pass does not mean all queries agree.

clippy_blockstore.initial_failure: New test manually constructed empty String; corrected with String::new().

pyroscope_native.note: Series/stats test includes cold-store replay. Other native Pyroscope and Grafana suites not run.

clippy_benches.initial_failure: Profile driver used if-then-panic fixture validation; changed to return Result error.

blockstore_unit_final.execution: Direct rustc --test, opt-level=1; exact cached dependencies selected using the prior Cargo unit fingerprint. Native and public integration tests use Cargo release binaries.

limitations: Index microbenchmarks and allocation profiles do not establish service-level gains over Mimir, Loki, Tempo or Pyroscope.

allocation_driver.note: Profile driver validation returns an error instead of panicking after Clippy; preserved heap captures use this earlier driver. Timed query wrappers are unchanged.

metrics.source_note: Three pairs measured the metrics change before the independent logs refinements. Metrics resolver and per-query workload are unchanged; the combined harness was split into separate Cargo targets. Final binary all-case sanity run is recorded separately.

nested_dictionary_refinement.note: All selective/equality controls lower in every pair. Broad negative controls mixed at 1k/10k/100k, lower in all pairs at 1m; prompted dedicated CPU profile.

broad_negative_profile.scope: Percentage of whole capture, including fixture construction; not an exact query CPU cost.
broad_negative_profile.decision: Skip per-series label checks and result reconstruction only when exact predicates and absent negative postings fully determine the answer.

trace_capacity_configuration.verification: Generated role configuration checked for both targets; real phase loop forwarded 1m cardinality for all four signals. Native Tempo deployment not run.

final_metrics_sanity.note: One final-binary pass; does not replace the original three-pair metrics comparison or qualify a broad-regex gain.
